sink.expr: db.Exec("UPDATE system_config SET value = ? WHERE key = 'admin_setting'", newConfig)

path.expr: db.Exec("UPDATE system_config SET value = ? WHERE key = 'admin_setting'", newConfig)

sanitizers.description: Constant SQL template with ? placeholder; newConfig bound as a parameter

gating_conditions.description: Gated by user.IsAdmin from extractUserFromToken (handlers.go:301-305), which does NOT validate JWT signatures/claims (BUG D-03). Attacker can forge a token with IsAdmin:true to reach this path — privilege escalation — but the SQL sink itself is parameterized and not injectable.

notes: SQL injection is NOT exploitable — db.Exec uses a constant template with a ? placeholder. NOTE: the gating condition relies on an unvalidated JWT claim (BUG D-03, privilege escalation) handled by authz-findings.json.
